geometry_limitations: Absolute heights/depths are photo-based estimates, not surveyed.
2025 front and2011 south facade references; south far-bay spacing and hidden rear openings remain provisional.

Only six central window assemblies have individually registered original photographic glazing; other surfaces retain geometric materials. No interiors or current-condition claim for historical fixtures.

source.author: Suicasmo
source.coordinate_contract: All controls are original EXIF-oriented pixels. Stored uv=(oriented_y/5184,(3455-oriented_x)/3456). No resampled image is embedded.
source.scope: Only six flat central third/fourth/fifth-floor glazing assemblies. Canted bays, attic, doors, stone, exterior shadows and occluded lower panes remain unprojected. The lower-left third-floor indoor dark reflection is inside real glazing, not a street object.
limitations: Manual outer glazing corners and per-pane registration are photographic estimates; not survey-grade photogrammetry.
Absolute front-plane u bias is not used to map glass.
No date claim beyond the referenced 2025 view.

verification.lod_bounds_acceptance: strictly less than limit, matching project verifier
verification.source_bounds_method: Referenced source POSITION vertices transformed through the full node hierarchy
verification.compressed_bounds_method: Accessor extrema with validated axis-aligned node transforms

limitations: No registration JSON, project asset or input file was modified.
Compressed vertex streams were not decoded for per-triangle comparison; bounds are not a Hausdorff test.
Native .blend geometry and external packed resources were not inspected with Blender; only header/bytes/SHA were checked.
No browser, Blender, render, visual-fidelity or photographic calibration check was run.
Only PhotoFacade_ base-color photos are replaced by an explicitly approximate tinted-glass material; other material textures are rejected by this opt-in policy.
Registration fields contain asset facts only; preserve or supply independently reviewed navigation, source and height fields.
